title: Regional dread scales with trauma over 50.0, saturates at 0.3 and never decides flight alone (AGENCY-06)
summary: Replaced panic += region_trauma * 0.5 with regional_dread (0.3 * min(1, trauma/50.0)); 13-case invariant test, before/after probes show trauma-alone flees 3 to 0; held out-of-range ATTACK loop traced and filed separately [layer=strategy]
